evidence.claim: Rocket Lab's SEC-filed Q1 2026 Form 10-Q reports USD 200.348 million of revenue split between USD 136.685 million of Space Systems and USD 63.663 million of Launch Services, with USD 2.220 billion of backlog. This establishes direct operating exposure to launch, spacecraft, component, and mission-system demand rather than ticker-level correlation.

The same filing records USD 50.332 million of operating cash use, USD 445.607 million of net ATM proceeds, material share issuance, one government customer at 36% of quarterly revenue, and backlog subject to timing, modification, termination, and fixed-price execution risk. These conditions limit confidence in durable common-share value conversion.

The current security assessment uses a validated USD 66.94 mark and bounded 12-month downside and base scenarios 79.3% and 56.9% below market, respectively, so accepting the causal edge does not justify strategy research or a signal.
